Sports Core Field Standard Principle 2: Tobacco smoke interferes with proper lung growth and function (p. 10).
Sports Core Field Standard Principle 3: It coats the lungs with sticky tars and injures the airways and air sacs of the lungs (p. 10).
Sports Core Field Standard Principle 4: Athletes need their lungs working at peak capacity (p. 10).
step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 (Sports Core Field Standard): Using tobacco can leave you gasping for air when you need (p. 10).
Step 2 (Sports Core Field Standard): Being tobacco-free gives you the stamina to plays ports (p. 10).
Step 3 (Sports Core Field Standard): The blood carries the poisons from smoking to all parts of the body, from the brain to the bladder (p. 10).
Step 4 (Sports Core Field Standard): Scientists now know that smoking causes cancers of the mouth, the larynx (voice box), the lungs, and the kidneys (p. 10).
